name: TAT-DQA
description: TAT-DQA is a table-based data question answering benchmark that assesses models' ability to answer questions grounded in tabular data. It includes a variety of question types (extractive, aggregative and compositional) requiring reasoning over table structure and cell contents.
reputation: Part of the table-benchmark collection on HuggingFace; used by researchers working on table QA and table understanding with modest community adoption.
